text:
Type: compact standing desk with drawers
Use: working or writing while standing, a laptop station; home office, hallway, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: white-stained birch veneer, solid birch legs, slatted shelf
Colors: pale whitewashed birch, light natural wood
Shape: tall narrow stand with a box-like top holding an open cubby and two small drawers with finger holes, four round splayed legs, a middle shelf and a slatted bottom shelf, slim and light
Feel: airy, light, practical, calm
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, linen, black lamps; Scandinavian or Japandi small spaces
